$comment: Measured design spec exported from the Bathroom Elevation Planner. All units are INCHES. This is the geometry any render MUST obey. x runs left-to-right along the 169" run of walls; y is height above finished floor (AFF); dep is depth into the room. See CONSTRAINTS.json for the hard rules and tolerances, and AI-SYSTEM-PROMPT.md for the text to hand a generation system.

shell.note: L-shaped room. A 14.5" recessed bay holds the tub, then the wall steps forward to the 50" vanity wall and the door zone.

walls.desc: Return face where the bay steps forward to the vanity wall
Left end wall (tub end / tap wall)

keyRelationships: Cabinet is EXACTLY 36" wide, 12" deep, 20" tall, underside 9" AFF.
Counter divides 23.6" basin + 1.5" open channel + 10.9" stone landing = 36.0" exactly.
Basin is OFFSET LEFT, flush with the cabinet's left end. It is not centred.
Basin and landing both project 13.8" — proud of the 12" cabinet by 1.8".
Basin rim 36" AFF. Cabinet top 29" AFF.
Splash panel is 60" wide, centred on the cabinet, rising from the cabinet top.
Mirror is a STADIUM/pill, centred on the 60" SPLASH — not on the offset basin.
Two identical vertical sconces flank the mirror. There is no bar light above it.
Taps are WALL-MOUNTED, 3-piece: spout centred, two cross handles flanking.
One metal throughout: copper. Taps, pulls, mirror frame, sconce bodies, splash trim.
Baseboard runs continuously and CONTINUES UNDER the wall-hung vanity.
Shower back wall is 14.5" behind the vanity wall.
Door starts exactly at the right edge of the vanity wall, x = 110.5".
Left sconce lives on the SHOWER SHELF WALL (face 14.5), not the splash panel — right sconce stays on the splash, flanking the mirror asymmetrically by design.
Door casing is a real frame (two jambs + head) with the opening cut through; baseboard dies into the casing rather than crossing the doorway.

fittings.name: Tiled backsplash panel
fittings.note: Large-format stone tile panel behind the vanity, 10" rounded top corners, thin metal trim on the exposed edge

fittings.name: Vanity wall shelf
fittings.note: Small walnut floating shelf on the tiled panel, right of the mirror

fittings.name: Baseboard
fittings.note: 4" painted baseboard, runs the full wall and CONTINUES UNDER the wall-hung vanity; dies into the door casing rather than crossing the doorway

fittings.name: Tub
fittings.note: Kohler 60" x 32" skirted bath in the back-left corner, rim 20" AFF, tiled end cap; tap wall on the tower-back plane

fittings.name: Storage tower
fittings.note: Full-height walnut, flat slab doors + drawers, brass bar pulls, two warmly lit open niches. Face coplanar with the vanity wall, back on the tub tap wall

fittings.name: Vanity
fittings.note: Wall-hung walnut, flat slab: 24" run of TWO full-width drawers + 1" gap + 11" bank of THREE small drawers under a stepped-up stone top

fittings.name: Vessel sink
fittings.note: Sits ON the counter — vessel basin, rim 38" AFF

fittings.name: Solid surface slab
fittings.note: Solid surface, stepped up on the counter to the RIGHT of the vessel sink

fittings.name: Tap handle — left
fittings.note: Round copper escutcheon + lever, level with the spout

fittings.name: Tap spout
fittings.note: Upright copper gooseneck spout, taller than the two round handle escutcheons beside it

fittings.name: Tap handle — right
fittings.note: Round copper escutcheon + lever, level with the spout

fittings.name: Mirror
fittings.note: Copper-framed rounded rectangle, stadium ends. Centred on the 46" splash panel, not on the offset basin

fittings.name: Door casing
fittings.note: 2.5" flat casing — real jambs + head with the door opening cut through, running down to the floor

fittings.name: Door — 30" RO
fittings.note: 30" RO starting near the right edge of the vanity wall; 1" of flat casing proud of the wall

fittings.name: Glass panel
fittings.note: Frameless panel on the open long side of the tub, sitting on the 20" rim

fittings.name: Floating shelves — shower wall
fittings.note: Floating boards, no brackets, LED strip under each board

fittings.name: Lit tile niche
fittings.note: RECESSED 4" into the tub tap wall — tile-lined back and reveals, LED strip washing each shelf

fittings.name: Rainhead
fittings.note: Brushed-copper rainhead on a ceiling-side arm, ~76" AFF on the tap wall

fittings.name: Mixer / diverter
fittings.note: Thermostatic valve + diverter, clear of the niche on the open side of the tap wall

fittings.name: Tub spout
fittings.note: Wall gooseneck spout above the 20" tub rim

fittings.name: Hand towel ring
fittings.note: Copper ring on the vanity return, beside the basin

fittings.name: Toilet
fittings.note: Against the right end wall, shifted toward the door end — seated you look straight down the room at the shower

fittings.name: Shower zone
fittings.note: Wet area over the bath — glass panel, rainhead and mixer all live inside this envelope

fittings.name: Sconce — right
fittings.note: VERTICAL copper cylinder sconce flush on the splash panel, right of the mirror

fittings.name: Towel bar — tub upper
fittings.note: Brass bar on the sloped wall, tub side

fittings.name: Towel bar — tub lower
fittings.note: Second brass bar, tub-side bay wall

fittings.name: Sconce — left
fittings.note: VERTICAL copper cylinder sconce on the SHOWER SHELF WALL, left of the floating shelves — moved off the splash panel

fittings.name: Hooded light — over mirror
fittings.note: Copper hooded picture light, shade angled down over the mirror, centred above it

bay.applies: shower back wall, step return, tub end

splash.applies: vanity splash panel — small hex, warm ivory

shelf_wall.applies: shower shelf wall — independent zone, own start/span

fieldGuide.x: Distance in inches from the left end wall, along the 169" run.
fieldGuide.w: Width in inches along that same run.
fieldGuide.y: Height above finished floor of the item's bottom edge.
fieldGuide.dep: Depth the item projects into the room.
fieldGuide.face: Which wall plane the item is mounted on: 0 = vanity wall plane, 14.5 = recessed bay plane.
fieldGuide.wall: "end" pins the item to an end wall, "slope" to the dormer slope; d is then its distance into the room.
fieldGuide.zoneOnly: Envelope for planning only — never drawn as an object.
fieldGuide.recess: Item is cut INTO the wall, not proud of it.
